info.title: Cartouche API
info.description: Cartouche public HTTP API. Errors are always `{"error":{"code","message","request_id"}}`.

get.description: Any user's card with its full content and its owner, even disabled. Read-only: support cannot edit a card.

403.description: The caller is not an approved administrator (`forbidden`, `account_pending`, `account_rejected`, `account_suspended`, `signup_closed`).

404.description: No such card (`not_found`).

get.summary: List the events of a card as support
get.description: The events of any card by start, each with its state and its number of contacts, even if the card is disabled. Read-only and not audited: the contacts themselves are (see the contact lists).

403.description: The caller is not an approved administrator (`forbidden`, `account_pending`, `account_rejected`, `account_suspended`, `signup_closed`).

404.description: No such card (`not_found`).

get.summary: List the contacts of a card as support
get.description: The contacts collected by every event of any card, from the most recent to the oldest, spam ones included and flagged, each with the title of its event. Read-only. Each request records an entry in the audit log before the contacts are sent; if the entry cannot be recorded, no contact is sent.

403.description: The caller is not an approved administrator (`forbidden`, `account_pending`, `account_rejected`, `account_suspended`, `signup_closed`).

404.description: No such card (`not_found`).

500.description: Unexpected failure, including a failed audit write (`internal_error`).

post.description: Blocks the card: its public page stops being served and its owner cannot reactivate it. The owner's own switch is kept. Recorded in the audit log.

200.description: The card, now disabled by support.

403.description: The caller is not an approved administrator (`forbidden`, `account_pending`, `account_rejected`, `account_suspended`, `signup_closed`).

404.description: No such card (`not_found`).

post.description: Lifts support's block. The card then follows its owner's own choice: it stays disabled if the owner had disabled it. Recorded in the audit log.

200.description: The card, no longer blocked by support.

403.description: The caller is not an approved administrator (`forbidden`, `account_pending`, `account_rejected`, `account_suspended`, `signup_closed`).

404.description: No such card (`not_found`).

409.description: Support has not disabled the card (`invalid_transition`).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id of the account to moderate.

200.description: The account with its new status.

get.description: The caller's cards, oldest first. Other users' cards are never listed.

403.description: The caller's account is not approved (`account_pending`, `account_rejected`, `account_suspended`, `signup_closed`).

post.description: Creates an active card with the source's template, settings, theme, content and links under a new slug, and a copy of its header and avatar. Slug history and uploads that are not attached are not copied. Refused while support has disabled the source.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id of the card to copy.

get.summary: List the events of a card
get.description: The events of the card by start, each with its state (`upcoming`, `running` or `past`, from the server clock), its access code in clear and its number of contacts. Events of a disabled card are listed too.

403.description: The caller's account is not approved (`account_pending`, `account_rejected`, `account_suspended`, `signup_closed`).

404.description: No such card for the caller (`not_found`).

post.description: Creates an event on the card. All invalid fields are reported at once. Refused with `too_many_simultaneous_events` when it would make more events of the card run together than the instance allows; concurrent creations cannot exceed the limit together.

400.description: Malformed id or body (`invalid_request`) or invalid fields (`validation_failed`).

403.description: The caller's account is not approved (`account_pending`, `account_rejected`, `account_suspended`, `signup_closed`).

404.description: No such card for the caller (`not_found`).

get.summary: List the contacts of a card
get.description: The contacts collected by every event of the card, from the most recent to the oldest, spam ones included and flagged, each with the title of its event. Contacts of a disabled card are listed too.

403.description: The caller's account is not approved (`account_pending`, `account_rejected`, `account_suspended`, `signup_closed`).

404.description: No such card for the caller (`not_found`).

get.summary: Export the contacts of a card
get.description: A file with the contacts of every event of the card, oldest first, each with its event, named `contacts-<card slug>-<date>.<extension>`. Contacts marked as spam are left out unless `include_spam` is true. Contacts of a disabled card are exported too.

parameters.name: include_spam
parameters.description: Keep the contacts marked as spam, flagged in their own column (default: leave them out).

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description:
IANA time zone of the dates and of the day in the file name, e.g. `Europe/Paris`; an
unknown or missing zone means `Europe/Paris`.

400.description: Malformed id, unknown format or malformed parameter (`invalid_request`).

403.description: The caller's account is not approved (`account_pending`, `account_rejected`, `account_suspended`, `signup_closed`).

404.description: No such card for the caller (`not_found`).

post.description: Stores an image (or, in the header, a video with its waiting image) and returns the media with the addresses of its files. The media is shown on the card only once a save of the card (`PUT /api/cards/{id}`) names it as header or avatar.

400.description: Malformed request or form (`invalid_request`) or refused file (`validation_failed`: `file` is `required`, `image_too_large` or `video_too_long`; `slot` is `required`; `poster` is `poster_required` or `image_too_large`).

413.description: The file is too heavy: 10 MB for an image, 25 MB for a video (`payload_too_large`).

415.description: The content is not a supported image or video (`unsupported_media_type`).

Nothing is saved on a refusal.

put.description: Sets whether the contact is spam. Repeating the same value is accepted. A spam contact stays in the event's list.

200.description: The contact, with its new mark.

403.description: The caller's account is not approved (`account_pending`, `account_rejected`, `account_suspended`, `signup_closed`).

get.description: The authenticated user's account, whatever its status. Creates the account on first visit when signups allow it.

403.description: Signups are closed for a new user (`signup_closed`).

delete.description: Deletes the caller's account, its cards, media (files included), events and leads. The card links stay blocked forever. Allowed whatever the account's status; refused to current administrators. All or nothing: if the media files cannot be deleted, nothing is deleted.

204.description: The account and all its data are deleted.

403.description: The caller is an administrator (`cannot_delete_admin`), or signups are closed for a new user (`signup_closed`).

404.description: The account no longer exists (`not_found`).

500.description: Unexpected failure, or the media files could not be deleted: nothing was deleted (`internal_error`).

get.description: No token needed. `active` carries the card, with a button for each event running now (by start, then title); `inactive` carries nothing (the card is disabled, deleted or its owner suspended); `redirect` names the current slug for an old slug or a slug written with capitals. A slug never attributed is a 404.

200.description: The card, the neutral state or a redirect.

404.description: The slug was never attributed (`not_found`).

get.description: No token needed. `open` carries the form. `code_required` and `closed` carry only the id and title of the event: the description, fields and consent text of an event with an access code are given by the unlock route after a correct code. An old slug or a slug with capitals reaches the event too. An event outside its submission window (from its start to 15 minutes after its end) is `closed`, whether or not it has a code.

200.description: The form, or what to do before getting it.

404.description: Unknown slug, or an event that is unknown, deleted or of another card (`not_found`).

post.description: No token needed. Stores the answers as a lead of the event, with the consent text shown with the form and the time of sending. Each address may make 120 sends per 10 minutes, accepted or refused, over every event; past that every send is `429 rate_limited` with `Retry-After`. The event must accept submissions (from its start to 15 minutes after its end). For an event with an access code, the code is checked again: a wrong or missing one is `403 invalid_access_code` and counts against the 30 wrong codes per address of the unlock route. A `form_version` that is no longer the form's is `409 form_changed`: reload the form. A device may send as many leads to an event as its device limit, leads marked as spam included. A send whose `fax` is not blank is answered like an accepted one and not stored.

400.description: Malformed id or body (`invalid_request`), or invalid answers (`validation_failed`, every invalid field listed).

403.description: Wrong or missing access code (`invalid_access_code`).

404.description: Unknown slug, or an event that is unknown, deleted or of another card (`not_found`).

409.description: The event does not accept submissions now (`event_closed`), the form changed (`form_changed`) or this device reached the event's limit (`device_limit_reached`).

429.description: Too many sends, or too many wrong codes, from this address (`rate_limited`).

post.description: No token needed. A correct code (or any code, for an event without one) returns the form. A wrong code is `403 invalid_access_code`. Each address may fail 30 codes per 10 minutes; past that every attempt is `429 rate_limited` with `Retry-After`, a correct code included. A correct code does not count.

403.description: Wrong access code (`invalid_access_code`).

404.description: Unknown slug, or an event that is unknown, deleted or of another card (`not_found`).

409.description: The event does not accept submissions now (`event_closed`).

429.description: Too many wrong codes from this address (`rate_limited`).

get.description: No token needed. A vCard 3.0 with the card's content, one `URL` per link and the profile photo (the smallest JPEG). An old slug or a slug with capitals answers 308 towards the current address; a card that is not served is `410 card_inactive`.

200.description: The vCard, as an attachment named `<slug>.vcf`.

308.description: Permanent redirect to the vCard of the current slug.

404.description: The slug was never attributed (`not_found`).

get.description: Whether the slug can be claimed by the caller for the card being edited (`card_id`), or for a new card when omitted. Never says who holds a taken slug.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The slug to check, in any case.

parameters.name: card_id
parameters.description: The card being edited, if any.

200.description: The slug's normalized form and status.

403.description: The caller's account is not approved (`account_pending`, `account_rejected`, `account_suspended`, `signup_closed`).

get.description: The first free slug among the name's base form, then the base with the suffixes `-2` to `-100`. `null` when the name gives no usable base or all are taken.

403.description: The caller's account is not approved (`account_pending`, `account_rejected`, `account_suspended`, `signup_closed`).

AddressInput.description: The postal address as typed by the prospect.

AdminCardDetail.description: One card with the account that owns it.

AdminEventList.description: The events of a card, as support sees them.

AdminUserDetail.description: An account and all its cards, whatever their state.

AdminUserView.description: An account as seen by an administrator.

AnswerSnapshot.description:
The answer to one custom field, with the label and type the field had at submission time
(FRM-022, FRM-038).

value.description:
A string (`text`, `long_text`, `single_choice`, `date` as `AAAA-MM-JJ`), a number
(`number`), a boolean (`checkbox`) or `null` when left empty.

AnswersInput.description: The answers of a prospect, as sent by the form (the `answers` of a submission).

custom.description: Answers to the custom fields, by field identifier.

oneOf.description: Linear gradient; `angle` is in degrees, 0 to 360.

CardView.description: A card as its owner sees it.

oneOf.description: The profile photo, once attached by a save (MED-018).
The header background, once attached by a save (MED-018).

template.description: Identifier of the template; any well-formed identifier is stored.

text.description: The default consent text for this card and title (FRM-029).

ConsentPreviewBody.description: The title to compose the default consent text for.

ContentInput.description: Card content as submitted: free text, not yet normalized.

phone_display.description: The phone in international format for display, when a phone is set.

CreateCardBody.description: A new card: its slug and, usually, the name to show.

CustomField.description: A field added by the owner, with a stable identifier (FRM-020, FRM-032).

options.description: Only for `single_choice`; empty for every other kind, and may then be left out.

fields.description: The invalid fields; present only for `validation_failed`.

message.description: Human-readable English explanation; clients should switch on `code`.

request_id.description: Id of the failed request, also sent in the `x-request-id` response header.

EventInput.description: Everything an owner submits for an event; also the body of the event routes.

device_limit.description: Submissions allowed per device, from 1 to 100 (EVT-014, EVT-030).

starts_at.description: Required; kept optional so that a missing start is reported as a field error.

EventPhase.description: Where an event stands relative to the server clock (EVT-020).

EventView.description: An event as its owner sees it: the access code is shown in clear (EVT-010).

consent_text.description: The owner's own consent text; absent when the default one applies.

default_consent_text.description: The consent text used when there is no custom one, for this card and title (FRM-029).

ends_at.description: Absent: the event lasts until it is ended (EVT-003).

lead_count.description: Every contact of the event, spam ones included.

ExportFormat.description: The file formats of an export (LEA-006).

FieldError.description: One invalid field of a request, reported with `400 validation_failed`.

field.description: Path of the field in the request, e.g. `content.email` or `links[3].url`.

FieldMode.description: Whether a standard field is absent from the form, optional or required (FRM-019).

db.description: `ok`, or `error` when the database is unreachable.

status.description: `ok`, or `degraded` when the database is unreachable.

width.description: Width in pixels (the side, for a profile photo).

leads.description: The contacts, newest first, spam ones included (EDI-020, LEA-013).

access_code.description: The code typed to unlock the form, for an event with an access code.

consent.description: Whether the consent box is ticked.

device_id.description: Identifier of the browser, kept in a cookie (EVT-028).

fax.description: Hidden trap field: the form always leaves it empty.

form_version.description: The `form_version` of the form the prospect filled in.

LeadView.description: A contact as the owner of its event sees it. The device that sent it is not shown.

answers.description: The answers to the standard fields; the phone number is in E.164.

consent_text.description: The consent text shown with the form, exactly (FRM-038).

custom.description:
The answers to the custom fields, with the label and type each field had when the
contact was sent (FRM-022).

event_title.description: The title the event has now.

phone_display.description: The phone number as people write it, e.g. `+33 6 12 34 56 78`.

spam.description: Marked as spam by the owner (ABU-003); spam contacts stay listed (ABU-009).

MediaView.description: An uploaded image or video and the addresses of its files.

images.description: The WebP variants, narrowest first; for a video, the waiting image.

jpeg_url.description: The largest JPEG variant, for a profile photo (vCard and link previews).

video_url.description: The MP4 file, for a video.

PublicCard.description:
A served card as any visitor sees it: no internal id and no date. The files' addresses
carry the media ids, so they are no secret.

events.description: The events running now, by start then title (PUB-008, PUB-009, PUB-029).

vcard_url.description: Where to download the contact card: `/api/public/cards/{slug}/vcard`.

oneOf.description:
The card is not served, whatever the reason (disabled, deleted, owner suspended):
nothing else is said (LNK-027).
The address is not the canonical one: an old slug or capitals (LNK-003, LNK-021).

PublicCardResponse.description: What a visitor gets for a slug.

PublicEventButton.description: A running event, as a button of the public card.

PublicEventForm.description: The form a prospect fills in. It never carries the access code, the device limit or dates.

consent_text.description: The text the prospect accepts, as it will be recorded (FRM-007, FRM-028).

form_version.description: Fingerprint of this form, sent back with the submission (FRM-030).

standard_fields.description: The enabled standard fields, in display order (FRM-017, FRM-019).

PublicEventHeading.description: What a visitor learns of an event whose form is not handed out: its title only (EVT-027).

oneOf.description: The form is open and needs no code.
The form needs the access code first: only the title is given.
The event does not accept submissions now: only the title is given.

PublicEventResponse.description: What a visitor gets for an event.

PublicStandardField.description: A standard field of the form, in display order (FRM-017).

SetStatusBody.description: The status to move an account to.

Slot.description: Where a media is shown on a card.

slug.description: The slug as normalized; `null` when it is invalid.
A free slug derived from the name, or `null` when the name gives nothing usable.

spam.description: `true` marks the contact as spam, `false` removes the mark.

StandardAnswers.description: Validated answers to the standard fields; an empty or disabled field is `None`.

StandardField.description: The standard fields an owner can enable (FRM-017).

StandardFields.description: The mode of each standard field.

StatusCounts.description: Number of accounts per status; all four are always present.

header_gradient.description: Intensity of the header gradient, 0 to 100.

preset.description: Preset identifier; an unknown one is accepted and falls back at render time.

access_code.description: The code as typed: case, surrounding spaces and accents do not matter.

UpdateCardBody.description: The whole editable content of a card; it replaces what is stored.

avatar_media_id.description:
The profile photo: one of this card's uploads in the `avatar` slot. Absent or null
removes it.

header_media_id.description:
The header media: one of this card's uploads in the `header` slot. Absent or null
removes it.

settings.description: Template-specific settings: a JSON object of at most 8 192 bytes.

theme.description: Received as raw JSON so that an invalid theme is a field error (`invalid_theme`).

UploadMediaBody.description: Shape of the multipart form, for the API description only.

file.description:
A JPEG, PNG or WebP image (10 MB, 40 million pixels at most), or in `header` an MP4
video (25 MB, 30 s at most). The type is read from the content.

poster.description: The waiting image of a video, captured in the browser. Required for a video.

slot.description: Where the media is shown. A video is only accepted in `header`.

bearer.description: Access token issued by the identity provider.
